summary: key=value extra vars are always strings; use JSON for booleans, numbers or lists.
questions: Why is my extra var a string instead of a boolean?
How do I pass multiple variables with -e?

answer_card.title: key=value extra vars
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
ansible-playbook release.yml --extra-vars "version=1.23.45 other_variable=foo"
```

Values passed this way are **strings**. Use JSON for booleans, integers, floats or lists.
